notes.title: Free Update: Arcade Mode and World 4!
notes.notes:
Diner Bros Inc now has two additional game modes for your multiplayer enjoyment!  Now introducing: The Arcade!  Play 6 curated minigames that allow players to truly work together cooperatively.  Can you beat the high score and earn all 6 achievements?  MG_Snake, MG_Match, MG_Dig, MG_Chop, MG_Waldo, and MG_Haircut are now available for both co-op or solo enjoyment in The Arcade.

The second update is the introduction of World 4, a collection of all minigames you have unlocked and purchased.  Stay on your toes as you jump from game to game; an achievement awaits the best teams!

And finally, a set of classic Diner Bros avatars is available to unlock in the store.  These guys are coming out of retirement just to help you! 

Update V1.3
New!

Arcade Mode: New! MG_Match, MG_Dig, MG_Chop, MG_Waldo, MG_Haircut
Arcade Mode: The top scoring player wins a point and a leaderboard is shown on the menu screen
World 4: a collection of all unlocked minigames
Six achievements for Arcade Mode and World 4
Classic DB avatar pack unlockable in the store


Changes!

Arcade Mode now available after unlocking World 2
Increased music volume during transitions
Renamed "Normal" difficulty as "Casual" difficulty


Bugs!

Fixed MG_Tiles background brightness
Fixed MG_Snake "Respawn" text showing in normal mode


Update V1.3a: Fixed achievements not unlocking

notes.title: Update 1.1: New Minigame/Boss + Difficulty adjustments
notes.notes:
Sick of grocery shopping? Me too! A new minigame/boss is now playable in Corporate Bros: MG_Simon!  Memorize!  Also included in this patch is a range of difficulty adjustments and quality of life improvements.  Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106171/af4d1e1b5d01f9c361bc1a2aa412dbf08aaa4c8b.png

New!

NEW MINIGAME: MG_Simon!
NEW BOSS: MG_Simon!

Changes!

Overall difficulty slightly decreased
Reduced level unlock requirement from 30 to 25
Duplicate levels prevented before boss level
MG_Platformer: Allow full jumping up to 0.3s after bouncing off enemy
MG_Cups: Slightly easier
MG_GameOver: Slightly easier
Moved MG_Photo to Hacker Bros Upgrade 3A
MG_Combo: Boss level slightly more time available
MG_Combo: Added tally icons to UI
MG_Asteroid: Slightly easier
MG_Safe: Controller spin speed increased
MG_Chef: Less time available at high levels
MG_Slapjack: Slightly easier at high levels

Bugs!

MG_Combo: UI fix

notes.title: Update 1.02: New Minigame + Misc. Improvements
notes.notes:

    MG_Archer: Archer animation on times up

Fixes!
